explanation_full: The analysis confirms that the KNN model is the best benchmark model, boasting an R2 score of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318. The top correlated features with HPR are VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641). The sequence diagnostics also provide detailed information, showing a sequence correlation of 0.931488 for the KNN model. These findings collectively support KNN's strong predictive capability based on key chemical indicators.
